## Work Unit / Jira task
- Jira: CITA-...
- WU lines changed: <1000 target (note exceptions)

## Acceptance and QA
- [ ] Unit tests / simulated portal tests
- [ ] Jenkins required status successful
- [ ] QA case(s) linked / evidence redacted
- [ ] No secrets, cookies or real DNI/NIE in commits or artifacts
- [ ] No new live-site traffic or booking automation
- [ ] Merge commit (not squash/rebase)
